blocks.x: Life & Annuities in Insurance & Risk: Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering as a production discipline. Achala tailors Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering to the life & annuities reality — pricing, claims and capital decisions all need model governance that Solvency II reviewers accept.

Through the Cloud, Edge & Platform lens, the operating reality: Life books run on decades-long promises: underwriting quality at issue, servicing responsiveness across 30-year relationships, and actuarial integrity across regime changes (IFRS 17/LDTI). The machinery deciding those outcomes is data and document heavy, ideal ground for governed automation.

What surrender and service queues costs is usually known only as a feeling. Turning that feeling into a signed number is the opening move; the engineering follows the evidence, never the other way round.

Inside Life & Annuities, Achala runs Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering under the same delivery standard as every engagement: Achala builds claims triage, pricing and underwriting platforms with model-risk documentation built in — Solvency II-aligned, with decisions auditors can walk alone. The baseline is signed before delivery starts.

items: Surrender, loan and beneficiary transactions route through document-heavy queues with abandonment risk.
Policy admin systems resist product change; new products take quarters.
APS records, paramedical data and financial underwriting arrive as documents; assembly consumes days per case.
Valuation and experience studies assemble from extracts with manual reconciliation; regime changes (IFRS 17) expose the debt.

blocks.x: In Life & Annuities, the pattern is admin modernization, strangler decomposition of policy admin wrappers. Product change lead time halved sits on top as the measured result, tracked from the signed baseline onward. Around it, the platform work decides the unit economics: right-sized runtimes, automated environments, and FinOps telemetry from the first workload. For Life & Annuities, this is the standard the build is held to.

instrumented path with gates and evidence

blocks.x: Delivery opens with measurement: the baseline for surrender and service queues is produced with your team and signed by whoever owns the number today. The working slice follows inside the quarter, Admin modernization, bounded to one path, running on your estate. Baselines are signed in the first two weeks, the working slice lands inside the quarter, and the value ledger stays open to your finance team.
Controls the auditor will ask about

For the Cloud, Edge & Platform side of Life & Annuities, the binding duties are concrete, IFRS 17 / LDTI (actuarial data and reporting discipline); GLBA/privacy regimes (health and financial data duties); State insurance regulation (unfair-claims and advertising rules). We design against them from the first sprint so the audit reads the system, not a binder.

The Cloud, Edge & Platform diagnostic in Life & Annuities comes before the contract: surrender and service queues gets baselined in two weeks; if the delta is real, the build gets scoped; if it is not, you keep the measurement design either way.
